name: Bohai Automotive Systems CO., LTD.
summary: Bohai Automotive Systems CO., LTD. engages in the manufacture and sale of various pistons in China and internationally. The company offers die-casting, laser remelting, integral forged steel structure, and ceramic internally cooled aluminum piston; articulated, composite, and monolithic piston. It also provides piston pin and wear resistant; and piston assembly products. The company's piston products are used in agricultural machinery, marine electric, construction machinery, commercial vehicle, passenger vehicle, and other industries.
